programmes.d: Disturbed by his daughter's marriage to an aspiring sculptor, Lifeguard intervenes when his son-in-law takes a construction job with a suspect company.
Vinnie attends his high school's 15th reunion, but he finds that rekindling old and valued friendships is sticky when his closest friends believe he's a gangster.
The only clue in a series of murders is a trail of police-issued ammunition that leads Hunter and McCall to suspect a colleague as the killer.
A boy is the only witness to the shooting of his parents. As McCall attempts to unravel the circumstances surrounding the murders, Hunter must get the boy to talk about the shocking incident.
Hunter and McCall enter the world of baby brokering when the murdered body of a call girl and an unharmed two-year-old are left in front of the woman's television set.
Tony suspects an apartment security chief may be a vigilante; Rachel's father shows up without warning and plans to stay a few days.
A drunk driver kills the wife of one of Tony's men and, because the driver is a doctor, the judge suspends his sentence.
Rachel backs a woman who says her ex-husband molested their daughter, but Tony has to arrest the woman for taking the girl from her ex, who has custody.
Vinnie is drawn into a plot to destabilize the Japanese economy led by Admiral Strichen and General Leland Masters.
After the funeral of the assassinated economist Andrew Valenti, Vinnie accelerates his investigation into the covert plot behind the professor's murder.
The pieces of the diplomatic puzzle begin to come together for Vinnie as General Masters puts the final touches on his plot to make Vinnie the fall guy.
